summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a right-handed male with composite Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma with CNS involvement, was admitted electively for his eighth cycle of high-dose methotrexate chemotherapy. He reported feeling well aside from a persistent floater in his left eye, which remained stable. He received methotrexate on day one with leucovorin rescue and aggressive IV hydration to maintain urine pH above 8.0. His renal function remained stable, though liver enzymes transiently elevated and subsequently trended downward. A brain MRI showed no new lesions or tumor recurrence, consistent with prior findings. His aspirin was restarted during admission. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to continue home medications and follow up for his next chemotherapy cycle in December.
problems: Other malignant lymphomas, unspecified site, extranodal and solid organ sites
